en: My answer is true.
My answer is false.

Question seven. The legal drinking age is eighteen. True or
false?
I hope it's true.
That's false.

Question eight. H is hydrogen, O is oxygen, and Na is
natrogen. True or false?
For sure, true.
For sure, false.

Question nine. French toast did not originate in France.
True or false?
I say true.
I say false.

Question ten. The French Revolution came before the
Russian Revolution. True or false?
Why, that's true.
Why, that's false.

Amazing! You got a perfect ten out of ten. That's odd,
Maya-chan. You seem to be a lot smarter than you initially
led us to believe.
Well, I, uh...
Sorry, you're not fooling anyone now. You're obviously just playing a silly character.
Join us next time on Sotenbori Love Check Quiz!

You scored surprisingly high. That's odd, Maya-chan. You
seem to be much smarter than you led us to believe.
Oh, no, I just...

Your score was more or less average. Do you think that will change
how your character is perceived?
Character? Maya doesn't understand, pon!

I see. Good for you, then. Join us next time on Sotenbori
Love Check Quiz!

I have to say, the results are what we expected. Were the
questions perhaps too challenging for a princess from the Strawberry Kingdom?

Ooh, oui, indeed they were. Much too hard for me,
paloomp.

Thank you for coming, Strawberry Maya. Join us next time on
Sotenbori Love Check Quiz!

Wow. A spectacular zero out of ten. That takes some doing,
even if you're guessing randomly. Was it perhaps too hard
for the Strawberry princess?
Ooh, oui, indeed it was. Much too hard for me, paloomp.
Wait a minute. Aren't you...?

It is you! I knew it! Sawamura-san, right? I'm Fuyumoto.
Surely you've heard of me?
No, I'm very sorry. I'm afraid I haven't.

That's funny. I'm on TV a lot. But I suppose you're much
too busy to watch TV. I've seen you on the Princess League,
by the way.

Anyway, I'm producing a special event right here in
Sotenbori.

The main goal of the event is to provide for the audience an
intense, exciting battle between idols, live and in person!

We gather nearly one hundred idols together in one spot and
have them perform, and then the live audience rates them by
voting!
Hmm. That sounds similar to the Princess League.

Yes, but what sets this event apart is that everyone can
come to see the whole thing live.
Live? Not pre-recorded?

That's right. Ninety-nine idols battling it out live on a
Sotenbori stage!

The event is called "Sotenbori Battle Royale 99," or "SBR99"
for short.

SBR99? Oh, I've heard of that! But I didn't know it was the
name of an event.

Yes. Many people are under the mistaken impression that it's
the name of a group. Anyway, I'm glad you've heard of it.

Idols compete in three categories: a dance battle, a concert
event, and a handshake event. The audience then votes on
those performances.

And now, to come to the point, do you think you might be
interested in competing in SBR99, Miss Sawamura?
Who? Me?

That's right. I'm sorry to ask you like this on the street
after a chance meeting, but I think this must be fate.

What do you think? SBR99 is a high-profile event, and I
believe taking part in it would be good publicity for you.
Hmm. Well...

And not only that, but I also think it would be a chance to
grow as well.
A chance to grow?

That's right. As I mentioned before, SBR99 takes place
before a live audience.

In this competition, idols get to experience the pressures
of direct audience voting in addition to a little friendly
competition. What better environment to help an idol grow?

I'm sure you'll find the experience of battling it out
with other idols of your generation in such an exciting
event to be truly enriching.
Hmm. It does sounds like it could be a good experience.

Most definitely! So, what do you say? Would you like to take
part? It's actually going on right now, so you could start
immediately.

(What should I do? If I lose, it could cause problems for my
agency.)

Let me give you some advice. I firmly believe it's better to
try something and regret it later than to regret not trying
it at all.

And I would say that all of the young ladies taking part in
SBR99 right now feel the same way. So how about it? Care to
give it a try?

Ah, that's too bad. But I guess I did ask you out of the
blue, so if you ever change your mind, please don't hesitate
to come back and see me.

I appreciate your joining us today, Sawamura-chan. We
certainly had an exciting SBR99 today, thanks to you.
Thank you very much for inviting me.

I'd love to ask you to come back again someday, but first,
I have a proposal for you.
A proposal? What is it?

Well, this is difficult to ask of you, but would you ever
consider leaving Dyna Chair?
I'd like you to join the talent agency I run, you see.
You're asking me to leave Dyna Chair?

I know it's very forward of me to ask. Please forgive me.
That said, yes. I have a plan to someday form a group from
all of SBR99's top performers.

That's my ultimate dream, you see. It's why I've been
talking to all the winners of SBR99, just as I'm doing with
you right now.
What do you say, Sawamura-san? Would you ever consider it?

I'm sorry, but I'm afraid not. Dyna Chair has made me what I
am today. I'm very grateful to them.

I was afraid you'd say that. I heard that you were
discovered by the Dyna Chair president, and that you came
all the way from Okinawa.

With all of that in mind, I didn't think it very likely that
you would say yes. Haha...

Still, after seeing your talent, I had to at least make an
effort to ask. I hope you can forgive me.

In that case, maybe we'd better make this your last SBR99,
so I won't be tempted to ask you again.

Here is your performance fee. Thank you again for taking
part.

I look forward to seeing what you'll do. I imagine even my
all-star group will have a hard time keeping up with you.
Sounds like I'd better watch out.

Haha, indeed. Well then, good luck to you, Sawamura-san. I'm
glad we had this chance to meet.

You can get changed for the event here. One of the staff
will come notify you once it's your turn to go on.
Okay. Thank you very much.

You'll begin with a dance battle. After that comes the
concert, and then we'll close things off with a handshake event.

For both the dance battle and concert event, you'll be
facing off against an opponent.
And if you're wondering who that opponent will be...
That'd be me! Right, Fuyumoto-san?
Heheh. Right you are, Ayumi.

Hello, Sawamura-san. I've been watching you on the Princess
League. Today's SBR99 should prove to be pretty interesting,
don't you think?

Please meet Ayumi Domoto. She's one of our most popular
participants, regularly voted number one. I thought she'd be
a good matchup for you.
It's very nice to meet you, Ayumi-san.

Listen, just because you've gained a little fame on TV,
don't think that's going to help you here! SBR99 fans are
pretty selective.

They aren't swayed by money or connections. They only care
about talent!

You're pretty brave to come waltzing in here. I just hope
you don't regret it once the votes are counted.

Now, Ayumi, please don't be rude. I was the one who had to
persuade Sawamura-san to join us here today.
That doesn't mean you want me to hold back, does it?

No, of course not. As a matter of fact, it would be
downright disrespectful to Sawamura-san.

Well, good. As long as I know it's all right to do my best,
I can relax and focus on my performance.

I hope you aren't upset, Sawamura-san. I'm sure Ayumi only
speaks this way because she's fiercely proud of her
accomplishments here.

But that's just the kind of keen competitive spirit that
SBR99 breeds. And it's all the better for it, I believe.
I'm not upset. I would have expected nothing less.

I'm glad to hear you say that. I have a feeling today's
competition will be more exciting than any other!

Well, we'd better let you get ready. Your turn will be
coming up soon.

And that concludes the handshake event! Thank you very much,
Haruka-chan! You handled that with such poise and grace.

You've captured the hearts of the audience, and it looks
like many of your fans were able to bask happily in the
warmth of your handshake!

And that concludes the handshake event! Haruka-chan, thank
you very much! Audience members, I certainly hope you
enjoyed yourselves!

But as I look around, I'm afraid I see a few disgruntled
faces. Perhaps some guests fared better than others?

That's a shame, and we sincerely apologize. Please
understand that even idols must get a little fatigued sometimes.

Thus concludes all three categories of SBR99, the event that
brings idols and fans together!

Voting has begun here in the event hall. We ask for your
patience as we tally the votes!
Did everyone enjoy today's Sotenbori Battle Royale 99?

SBR99, an intense battle between idols unfolding right
before your very eyes! And today certainly has been just
that. I will now announce the results!

Now then, bringing up the rear in ninety-ninth place, we
have...

It looks like first place is either going to be you or me. I
underestimated you at first, Haruka-chan, but I have to
admit, you're head and shoulders above the rest.
Oh, I don't know about that. I still have a lot to learn.

And on top of everything else, you're a nice person, too.
Anyway, let's see what the results say.
No matter who wins, we won't hold any grudges. Agreed?
Of course not. Agreed.

And now, we've finally come to our top two competitors! Who
will be number one, and who will be number two!?
Are you ready to hear the voting results!?

Coming in second place in today's SBR99 is Ayumi Domoto!
That means Haruka Sawamura is number one!

Aw, I lost. Well, it looks like you're the big winner today,
Haruka-chan. Go ahead and step forward.

You win, Haruka-chan! Please step forward and say a few
words to our lovely audience!
Oh! Okay!
Thank you very much to everyone who voted for me today.

And, of course, whether you voted for me or not, thank you
very much for participating in today's Sotenbori Battle
Royale 99!

This was the first time I ever tried SBR99, and it was
absolutely wonderful. I'm really glad we got to spend this
time together! Thank you!

Coming in second place in today's SBR99 is Haruka Sawamura!
That means Ayumi Domoto is the winner!

Well, it looks like I won today, Haruka-chan, but it was a
really great competition. Thank you for everything.
Thank you! Congratulations, Ayumi-san.

Ayumi and Haruka-chan, as our top two competitors, please
step forward and say a few words to our audience!
Hmm? Oh! All right!

This was the first time I ever tried SBR99, and it was
absolutely wonderful.

I may not have won today, but I'm glad to have been part of
such an amazing competition with such an amazingly talented
and dedicated group of girls.

It made me realize all the more that I have to keep working
as hard as I can. Thank you, everyone!

Such a wonderful performance! I think I nearly forgot to
breathe! It's easy to see why Haruka Sawamura is doing so
well in the Princess League!

What will become of the other SBR99 challengers if our new
contestant walks away with the top spot on her very first try!?

It will all be up to you, the audience, to cast your votes
and decide!

Hmm, you looked like you were having a bit of a hard time
out there, Haruka-chan. Did the unfamiliar stage make you
a little nervous, perhaps?

Nevertheless, the final decision rests in the hands of the
audience members. I can't wait to see the results!

And what's more, the competition isn't over yet! There's
still one more SBR99 category to come!

It's time now for the handshake event! Let's see how much
warmth and enthusiasm our idols greet their fans with!

Being an idol isn't just about technical skill, after all.
Heartfelt appreciation for their fans is every bit as important, if not more so.
Now then, on to the handshake event!
(Let's see. I should be good now, right?)

Splendid, just splendid! An incredible battle between two
well-matched opponents!

It appears clear that these girls are vying for the top two
spots out of ninety-nine!

Hey, you did better than I expected! I thought your
popularity might've been just a fluke, but now I see you
really know your stuff.
And I can see why you're the SBR99 ace!
